findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): section#booking.villa-home__booking → linear-gradient(112deg, rgb(16, 31, 54) 0%, rgb(23, 46, 77) 37%, rgb(48, 76, 115) 68%, rgb(20, 35, 59) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 700px of nothing between: "A welcoming place to gather."
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.
